win_reward: ✓ Fear kept a warning, not a prophecy.
fullRitual:
THE TWO-CUE MERGE

GOAL
Combine mastered signals only after each can stand alone.

1. Select Triggers — Select two triggers already manageable separately.
2. Predict Joining — Predict what joining them will add.
3. Drop Unnecessary — Contact both at a modest dose while dropping unnecessary escape.
4. Stay Long — Stay long enough to compare the combined result with the prediction, then recover fully.

WIN
✓ Fear kept a warning, not a prophecy.

TIPS
• Keep the habit pull small enough to see clearly.
• Choose a different response even if automatic behaviour has not disappeared.
• Make room for a different response instead of feeding autopilot.
• Keep choice visible when the habit pull gets loud.
• Stay close to a new pathway when mindless repetition feels tempting.

MIND BEND
The first story arrived first, not necessarily best. Combine mastered signals only after each can stand alone

FORMULA FLOW
Select Triggers → Predict Joining → Drop Unnecessary → Stay Long

SAFETY
PAUSE
Do not compound unmastered trauma cues or exceed the planned tolerance range.
This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.
